summary.text: Brad Hochgesang is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Daryl Schmitt.
A software developer from Jasper, he says his campaign is about accountability and local representation.

paragraphs.text: Brad Hochgesang graduated from Jasper High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a software engineer and small business owner who moved back to Jasper in 2023.
He said he began his campaign after learning of a proposed highway project in Dubois County, commissioned a poll of 636 registered voters that he said found 81% opposed, and organized ten town halls.
